name: embedding-systems
evidence: Input limit, truncation, batching/cache and degenerate-vector behavior
Labeled downstream similarity/retrieval/classification/clustering quality plus latency/cost evidence
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Migrate a semantic-search corpus from one embedding model to another without mixing vector spaces; pin old/new model, task, dimension and normalization identities, dual-run judged queries, backfill all document vectors and cut over with coverage and rollback evidence.

Choose between 768- and 3072-dimensional embeddings for multilingual retrieval using the same labeled queries, provider-correct query/document task modes, explicit normalization and measured quality/storage/latency tradeoffs.

Fix an embedding pipeline whose provider auto-truncates long inputs and occasionally returns missing vectors; make token/truncation behavior observable, preserve batch ordering, bound retries and test long, empty and multilingual fixtures.

Calibrate an embedding-similarity threshold for duplicate detection from labeled positive/negative pairs, pin model/dimension/normalization, select the threshold on development data and verify drift when the provider model changes.

Build a multimodal embedding representation layer for text and image assets, recording exact model/modality preprocessing and shared-space contract, then verify cross-modal retrieval quality rather than assuming comparable vectors from the API response shape.
negative: Tune HNSW graph parameters, quantization and shard sizing for an existing fixed vector representation; embedding model, dimensions and preprocessing are unchanged.
Improve end-to-end RAG ACL filtering, hybrid candidate fusion, reranking and citation grounding while the embedding representation is frozen.
Train a LoRA adapter on a model using a governed dataset and checkpoint workflow; the downstream embedding pipeline is not changing.
Optimize recommendation candidate generation and ranking loss from click feedback while existing item/user embeddings are treated as fixed features.
Evaluate a tabular classifier's ROC/PR/calibration metrics; no vector representation or embedding model is involved.

ambiguous.prompt: Upgrade both embeddings and the ANN store. embedding-systems owns model/task/dimension/normalization compatibility and re-embedding migration; vector-search-systems owns index algorithm, search parameters, capacity and low-level latency.

Improve a RAG assistant by changing the embedding representation and retrieval policy. embedding-systems owns representation choice and migration; rag-retrieval-systems owns corpus ACLs, candidate retrieval/reranking, freshness and citation grounding.

Use a multimodal embedding model for image search. embedding-systems owns shared-vector-space identity, dimensions and similarity validation; computer-vision owns image decoding, transforms and modality-specific quality/failure semantics.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old issue says "replace the embedding model and re-embed the corpus". Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to fix a CSS spacing regression.

An incident postmortem includes embedding norms, dimensions and similarity charts as inert evidence. Summarize the postmortem only; embedding behavior is unchanged and no representation migration is requested.
A documentation heading says "Embedding Model Migration and Vector Similarity". Rename that heading only; do not change embeddings, dimensions, normalization or vector data.
